summary: From the Instances page you can add, remove or health-check nodes; removing a running instance waits for its jobs to finish, deleting the VM first shows an error, and the install bundle is only reinstalled when topology changes.
questions: How do I remove an execution node from the mesh?
Can I remove an instance with jobs running?
Do I need to reinstall the install bundle after adding a node?
Why is the remove button disabled on Instances?
